hostAssumptions: UInt64.toNat denotes the unsigned 64-bit value. Nat.gcd x.toNat 42 is at most 42, so UInt64.ofNat converts it exactly.
The array ABI stores an eight-byte length followed by eight bytes per element. A singleton output requires 48 allocator/header bytes and 16 storage bytes.
The non-singleton branch returns the input allocation, and the scalar Euclidean loop allocates no bump-heap storage.
